scientific_integrity: Explicit orbit-forest model, shellability via published complete-source and expansion results, and directed forest determinant proof. Computational finite checks support but do not prove the unrestricted theorem. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary Morse complex only; nontrivial involutions only; no stronger equivariant homotopy claims. Euler formulas covered by earlier graded character results. An unindexed prior fixed-space homotopy classification remains a possible originality risk.
title: Geometric involution fixed points of complete-graph discrete Morse complexes
